svg.title: A cubic channel
svg.desc: One Blender channel exported as a cubic spline: the left thigh's rotation over the one-second walk, as degrees from its first key. The file's Hermite curve passes through its nine keys; the imported linear keys, 61 of them marked as ticks on the time axis, follow it so closely the two lines coincide. The same curve evaluated with the tangents not scaled by the interval length is visibly flatter and misses by up to tens of degrees.
svg.text: thigh.L, walk, Blender with sampling off: degrees from the first key
ticks: the 61 keys the importer wrote, from the file's 9
